# Read-only server invariant

The server never performs compilation; it only reads whatever state the last CI-invoked compile produced.

Ensure the server is a read-only view of the compiled knowledge base so compilation is centralized in CI and the server cannot modify the repository's knowledge state.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/server.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.server.build_server`
- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/server.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.server.serve`
